prompt:
You receive 2 images. Image 1 is a finished winter background painting of our point-and-click adventure game: the paved forecourt of Hotel Grand Jasna at Jasna, view to Chopok on 6 February 2035. Image 2 is the same painting with coloured boxes that only mark the interactive objects, the exits and the walkable floor. Make ONLY the change described below and keep everything else in image 1 exactly as it is: the same camera, framing, buildings, trees, snow, light, colours, brushwork and level of detail.

The only change: the paved forecourt the band at x 0-1920, y 652-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 60-94 % from the top) must be clear right to the left, right and bottom edges of the picture.
Remove every snow bank, snow pile and drift that lies on the paving in the lower part of the picture - at the left
edge, in the bottom left corner, along the bottom edge and at the right edge - and continue there the same grey
paving stones with the same perspective tile lines, the same thin dusting of snow and a few faint footprints, so the
forecourt is ONE continuous flat paved surface out of the left edge (the box labelled 'exit: Biela Púť pri dolnej stanici' in image 2 (x 0-60, y 712-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-3 % from the left, 66-94 % from the top))), the bottom edge and the right
edge. Keep the big spruce (the box labelled 'Tieň stromu' in image 2 (x 300-560, y 470-740 of the 1920x1080 frame (16-29 % from the left, 44-69 % from the top))) and its long blue shadow on the paving exactly as they are, and the
luggage trolley (the box labelled 'Batožinový vozík' in image 2 (x 1440-1580, y 462-724 of the 1920x1080 frame (75-82 % from the left, 43-67 % from the top))) exactly as it is. Keep the narrow low strip of snow
along the foot of the stone walls and at the hotel wall. Everything above the forecourt (the hotel, the spruce, the
walls, the banner, the table, the fountain, the trolley, the mountains, the sky) stays exactly as in image 1.
NPC zone at x 843-958, y 535-772 of the 1920x1080 frame (44-50 % from the left, 50-71 % from the top): an animated character sprite will be drawn here later, so paint no person, figure or silhouette in it. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 770.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no new text, no people or animals.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
